selection_rule: Earliest candidate with a fully 15-month-mature training window beginning 2022-01-01; maximize fully mature post-freeze holdout span ending 2023-09-30. Use all vehicles, not outcome-dependent role restrictions.
primary: temporal; may include previously observed vehicles; only index-time predictors
secondary: same fitted model; evaluation subset whose vehicle IDs never occur in training
reference: Preserve Phase 2 vehicle-role split, 705 train / 183 holdout, without retraining or changing it
preprocessing: Nonfinite/negative age or nonpositive mileage -> missing. Median imputation plus missing indicators, then standard scaling, all fitted on training only. Counts must be integers, brakes >=1, total >= brakes.
tie_break: Ascending SHA256 of btp-capacity-v1:<test_id>; never labels; IDs are audit-only, not predictors
development: No independent mature chronological development partition; no tuning/search/calibration or production-winner selection
uncertainty: No intervals estimated in this bounded exploratory phase
snapshot_selection: Latest uniquely dated recorded inspection per vehicle must itself be eligible NT/P/brakes-A; deterministic test-ID hash ordering, never outcomes. Historical demonstration as of 2024-12-31.
recurrence: Descriptive only; predictive value unvalidated; excluded from model
availability: Retrospective event/completion proxies, not actual historical public-release availability
